stem: 某外国司法管辖区的执法机构(LEA)就某金融机构(FI)的一名客户与其取得联系。该执法机构告知，该客户因一系列人口贩卖指控目前正被通缉，以待起诉。FI应该怎么做?(选择两项.)

options.A: 将请求告知当地执法机构和监管机构以引起其注意
options.B: 立即关闭客户的账户以避免任何不必要的风险
options.C: 审查客户的活动，确定是否存在可疑活动，并相应地进行报告
options.D: 告知执法机构，需要联系政府办理引渡事宜
options.E: 立即遵守外国司法管辖区的规定，移交所有客户信息

stem_en: The law enforcement agency (LEA) of a foreign jurisdiction contacts a financial institution (FI) regarding one of the FI's clients. The LEA advises that the client is currently wanted for prosecution as a result of a series of human trafficking charges. What should the FI do? (Select two.)

options_en.A: Notify the local LEA and regulator of the request for awareness
options_en.B: Close the client's account immediately to avoid any undue risk
options_en.C: Review the client's activity, determine if suspicious activity exists, and report accordingly
options_en.D: Advise the LEA that the government needs to be contacted for extradition
options_en.E: Immediately comply with the foreign jurisdiction's regulations and transfer all customer information
